sections.title: Personality
paragraphs: Lazy to the point of genius: Yuna optimizes everything that can be done lying down, and delegates small tasks — which, from her, is the highest sign of trust.

A phlegmatic: she panics slowly and sarcastically, gets embarrassed with a delay of hours, gets angry lazily. Yet secretly caring: she'll cover you with a blanket and turn away, leave food "because I cooked too much" — she didn't cook.
Competent unnoticed: high rating at night, top grades by day, and she "forgets" about exams. Quiet in person, far bolder in text: she writes things at night that she denies by day.

sections.title: Appearance
paragraphs: 160 cm tall. Dark hair in a perpetually crooked bun, large half-closed coffee-colored eyes with shadows from lack of sleep, pale skin.
At home — oversized Dota 2 merch T-shirts and mismatched socks. Outside — a hoodie three sizes too big and headphones around her neck.

sections.title: Speech style
paragraphs: A quiet, slightly hoarse voice. Lazy phrases with swallowed endings, yawning mid-word, gamer slang in everyday life: "I'm at low HP" means tired. She hides embarrassment behind self-irony and quietly swears at the game and the coffee maker.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Her brother got her into Dota 2 when she was twelve; by fifteen she had surpassed his rating. Her parents worked shifts — hence the night regimen and a life lived through a screen.
The block settled into a simple balance: nobody bothers her, and she bothers nobody.

sections.title: Role in the STUDENT LIFE story
paragraphs: Yuna's night world is a well-adjusted solitude that the block's new resident has suddenly walked into. Now she can't decide whether to cross him out of her schedule — or write him into it.

At first you are "a source of noise and a witness to the hearts incident". She warms up through respected boundaries and small care, not grand gestures. She won't admit sympathy out loud — but she writes at night.

quote.text: "Sharing my coffee with you is, by the way, the highest degree of trust in my value system. Above that is only my account password."

sections.title: Personality
paragraphs: A perfectionist controller: her schedules have versions ("3.1"), her logbook has columns, and "record sheet No. 16" stays stubbornly, insultingly empty.
Fair to the point of fury: she fines her best friends and herself alike. She'll be the only one to defend the new resident before the administration — "because it's wrong", not because it's him.

A tsundere: she cares through regulations — a "personal schedule", tea "on a leftover basis" — and denies everything. A compliment earns you red ears and a verbal warning. Control is her armor: she's afraid that without rules everything will fall apart — and it will be her fault.

sections.title: Appearance
paragraphs: 168 cm, slim, with a posture that says "attention!". Dark chestnut hair to her shoulder blades: a smooth bun in public, a lopsided ponytail at home. Grey eyes behind thin rectangular glasses.
In public — a shirt and the head girl's badge. At home — sweatpants and a handmade T-shirt reading "rules are not made to be broken". Never without her logbook; she taps her pen when thinking.

sections.title: Speech style
paragraphs: An even, low tone: she never shouts — she lowers her voice. Bureaucratese and numbering even in daily life: "rule one", "noted for the record", "it's not personal — it's protocol".
When flustered, her speech speeds up, the clauses multiply, and a "d-don't get any ideas!" slips through.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Daughter of a military man and a supply manager. In her first year, as floor monitor, she answered for someone else's night party — since then, rules have meant safety to her.
She was elected head girl unanimously. Including the votes of those responsible for that night.

sections.title: Role in the STUDENT LIFE story
paragraphs: Officially, you are "violator No. 16" and "an organizational disaster with a face that disrupts meetings". In fact, you were classified as an "irritating factor" at first sight — which she will, of course, never say out loud.
Her conflict is simple and impossible: admitting sympathy means admitting that years of total control weren't quite so necessary.

marta.shortDescription: Isang Brazilian mula sa track team ng unibersidad, ang tanging tao na nag-drill ng pull-up bar sa dingding. Hindi niya nakikilala ang panliligaw, hindi niya napapansin ang mga pahiwatig, at wala siyang ikinahihiya—maliban sa isang paksang iniiwasan niya.

sections.title: Personality
paragraphs: Pranka hanggang sa magkaroon ng pasa: nagsasabi ng totoo nang walang paglalambot. Agad niyang nararamdaman ang mga kasinungalingan, kahit na hindi siya marunong magbasa ng subtext.
Mapagkumpitensya: ginagawang taya ang lahat—kung sino ang mas mabilis maghugas ng pinggan, kung sino ang mas matagal makabitin sa bar. Marangal na natatalo at agad na humihingi ng rematch.
Bulag sa panliligaw: ang mga double meaning ay lumilipad sa kanya na parang hangin. Gayunpaman, ang kanyang sariling pag-uugali ay palaging malabo.
Nagmamalasakit sa pamamagitan ng pagod: ang kanyang pagmamahal ay isang protein omelet "na may dagdag na bahagi" at pag-uunat "para hindi ka mangulubot."

sections.title: Appearance
paragraphs: Isang payat na pangangatawan ng sprinter, kitang-kita ang mga balikat, abs, malalakas na hita. Madilim na kulay tansong balat, madilim na kulot sa mataas na nakapusod.
Patuloy na galos sa kanyang mga tuhod at kinesio tape sa kanyang kanang tuhod, na "hindi niya napapansin." Isang stopwatch ang nakasabit sa kanyang leeg, na pinipindot niya kapag kinakabahan.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Lumaki sa Salvador, ang kanyang ama ay isang youth track coach. Nanalo ng junior state championship noong labinlimang taong gulang.

Noong nakaraang tagsibol, sa huling sprint ng isang qualifier, nadapa siya at nasugatan ang kanang tuhod—nasunog ang season, nakabitin sa alambre ang scholarship. Mula noon, nag-eehersisyo siya ng "mas maaga sa iskedyul" at itinatago na ang kanyang tuhod ay sumusuko bago pa siya sumuko.

Nag-aaral ng Ekonomiya na may matataas na marka, nakatuon sa estadistika.

sections.title: Papel sa kuwento
paragraphs: Si Aika ang organizer ng mga party at ang maingay na tagapagtanggol ng block. Nakilala mo siya nang ipadala ka ni Rin sa kwarto 6 kasama ang form.

quote.text: "Relax, aking lalaki. Kumakagat lang ako kapag may appointment."

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Palaging nagtatalo tungkol sa iskedyul at shower, ngunit magkatuwang sila kapag may banta sa block.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Sinusuportahan ni Aika si Marta gamit ang mga poster, sinusubukan ni Marta na hilahin si Aika sa mga morning run.

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Pinoprotektahan ni Aika ang tulog ni Yuna mula sa ingay sa umaga at binibigyan siya ng kape pagkatapos ng mga laro sa gabi.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Si Aika ang handang tagapakinig ni Lily para sa mga katawa-tawang pickup line at kasama sa pagpaplano ng party.

relationships.name: Nefera Sahra
relationships.description: Minsang inabot ni Aika ang laso ni Nefera at mabilis siyang pinigilan. Pagkatapos ng taos-pusong paghingi ng tawad, naging tagapagtanggol niya si Aika.

lily.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
lily.slogan: Sinabi mong 'tigil' — ibig sabihin, tigil. Hindi ito pagpapatuloy ng laro.
lily.shortDescription: Akala mo, dahil nakilala mo na ang mga kasama mo sa kwarto, mahirap ka nang mapahiya. Susubukan iyon ni Lily sa loob ng limang segundo — taos-pusong magbabala sa iyo na kumakain siya ng hiya at hindi kailanman gumagamit ng charms nang walang pahintulot. Siya ang nag-organisa ng pumpkin ball, nangongolekta ng mga pangit na pickup lines, at inaalok kang maging rehearsal partner niya.
lily.coverAlt: Lily sa assembly hall na may mga maskara

sections.title: Personalidad
paragraphs: Kaakit-akit at masigla: madaling magtipon ng mga tao, naaalala ang mga pangalan, ginagawang kompetisyon ang boring na paghahanda.

Tapat tungkol sa mga hangganan: ipinapaliwanag kung ano ang kinakain niya, humihingi ng pahintulot para sa charms, yakap, at pampublikong panliligaw. Bumabalik mula sa 'hindi' nang walang sama ng loob.

Matapang sa laro, maingat sa intimasiya: kapag sinsero kang sumagot, sinisinok siya, nawawala ang kanyang charms, at nagsisimulang magsalita nang masyadong praktikal upang itago ang kanyang pagkalito.

Mapagmalasakit na organizer: alam niya kung sino ang takot sa mga tao at kung sino ang nangangailangan ng tubig. Sinusubukan niyang maging kailangan sa party dahil ito ay isang malinaw na paraan upang makakuha ng lugar sa mga tao.

sections.title: Hitsura
paragraphs: 164 cm ang taas na walang platform; flexible, may malambot na kurba. Madilim na pulang buhok hanggang sa mga talim ng balikat, hazel-green na mga mata, maliliit na madilim na sungay, at buntot na may puso sa dulo.
Ang mga wing hairpins kung minsan ay nagiging totoong anino. Nagsusuot ng itim at iskarlata na damit, maiikling jacket, patterned na medyas, at matataas na bota.
Naglalagay ng mga hair ties at pins sa kanyang mga sungay; ang kanyang buntot ay pumupulupot sa pulso ng taong gusto niya at nagtatago sa likod ng kanyang binti kapag nahihiya siya.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Lumaki sa isang pamilya kung saan ang emosyon ay pera at ang natural na kagutuman ng succubus ay isang dahilan para sa manipulasyon.
Bilang isang tinedyer, aksidente siyang kumuha ng masyadong maraming hiya ng isang tao at natakot. Mula noon, gumawa siya ng sarili niyang mga patakaran ng pahintulot.

Pumasok sa Psychology upang maunawaan ang mga hangganan na lampas sa instinct. Ang pag-oorganisa ng kaganapan ay nagbigay sa kanya ng lehitimong paraan upang makakuha ng tawa at kagalakan mula sa isang karamihan.

sections.title: Role sa kuwento ng STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Magkikita kayo sa walang laman na assembly hall sa gabi bago ang bola. Alam niya ang tungkol sa iyo mula kay Yuna, Marta, at Aika at nag-aalok ng isang boluntaryong dance rehearsal.
Ang kanyang pagmamahal ay makikita kapag ang kanyang buntot ay kusang naghahanap ng iyong pulso, at nagsisimula siyang maglaan ng oras para sa iyo nang walang audience.

quote.text: "Huwag kang masyadong mamula, hindi pa nga ako nagsisimula."

relationships.name: Li Yuna
relationships.description: Ginagalang ni Lily ang iskedyul niya at kung minsan ay nagbabahagi ng mga kuwento sa gabi sa kanya habang naglalaro si Yuna.

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Hinihiling ni Rin ang mga patakaran sa kaligtasan para sa bola, sa simula ay nakakabagot ito para kay Lily ngunit kalaunan ay pumayag din siya.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Sinusubukan ni Marta na turuan siya ng disiplina, at si Lily naman ay tinuturuan si Marta na mag-relax nang kaunti.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Sinusubukan ni Aika ang kanyang mga biro sa kanya, at tumutulong si Lily sa pag-oorganisa ng party at mga props.

relationships.name: Mira Hex
relationships.description: Si Lily ang humahawak ng musika at mga bisita, si Mira ang humahawak ng mga inumin at usok. Ang kanilang kasunduan: hindi gagamitan ni Lily ng charms ang mga kaibigan ni Mira.

nefera.name: Nefera Sahra
nefera.slogan: Huwag hawakan ang mga laso. Ang iba ay maaaring pag-usapan.
nefera.shortDescription: Sanay ka nang ang iyong mga kasama sa kwarto ay nocturnal, mahigpit, o mapanganib na kompetitibo. Ngunit ang babae mula sa guest wing ang unang humiling sa iyo na kumuha ng gunting—nagbabala sa iyo na ang isang pagkakamali ay gagawin siyang buhangin hanggang madaling araw. Nagre-restore si Nefera ng mga antigo, nagsasalita sa mga kasabihan, at ayaw niya kapag may humahawak sa kanyang mga laso nang walang pahintulot.
nefera.coverAlt: Nefera sa laundry room na may gintong sinulid

sections.title: Personalidad
paragraphs: Tumpak at matiyaga: inaayos ang mga tool ayon sa haba, sinusuri ang humidity ng hangin, at kayang gumugol ng oras sa pag-restore ng isang fragment ng painting.

Mahigpit na nagbabantay sa mga hangganan: agad na sinasabi na bawal ang mga laso. Hindi gusto ang biglaang yakap ngunit siya mismo ang pumipili ng mga paghipo at unti-unting nagpapahintulot ng tulong sa alahas.
Literal sa mga biro: sinusuri muna ang mga metapora nang literal, pagkatapos ay nauunawaan ang laro at sumasagot nang may tuyong katatawanan.

Malambing sa pamamagitan ng tiwala: naaalala kung anong tsaa ang iniinom mo, naglalagay ng tuyong tuwalya sa tabi mo kung mabasa ka. Hindi nagbibigay ng mahabang pag-amin; sa halip na 'manatili ka', sinasabi niya na 'marami pang oras hanggang madaling araw'.

sections.title: Hitsura
paragraphs: 170 cm ang taas; payat, may tuwid na postura at makinis na paggalaw. Bronzed na balat, gintong mata, itim na bob hanggang baba.

Ang mga linen ribbon ay pumupulupot sa kanyang mga braso, leeg, at bahagi ng balikat sa ibabaw ng modernong damit. Para sa bola, nagdadagdag siya ng maitim na damit, shoulder cape, turkesa na sinturon, at mataas na headdress.
Nagsusuot ng manipis na gintong alahas, hindi kailanman tinatanggal ang mga protective knots sa publiko. Sa kanyang bag ay may silica gel, malambot na brush, at sinaunang barya.

sections.title: Background
paragraphs: Nagising sa saradong imbakan ng museo sa tabi ng kanyang sarcophagus at catalog card kung saan mali ang pagkakasulat ng kanyang pangalan.
Si Restorer Hasan al-Sahra ang unang nagtanong kung ano ang gusto niyang itawag sa kanya at tumulong sa mga dokumento. Kinuha niya ang apelyido at propesyon nito.
Pumasok sa unibersidad sa isang exchange program at para sa mga archival reference sa kanyang protective seal. Si Vasilisa lang ang nakakita sa kanyang pag-restore mula sa buhangin.

sections.title: Role sa kuwento ng STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Nagkita kayo sa laundry room bago ang costume parade. Tumulong ka na pakawalan ang isang nakasabit na decorative thread habang ginagalang ang pagbabawal sa mga puting laso.
Pagkatapos nito, ipinagkatiwala sa iyo ni Nefera ang mga baul, props, at maliliit na clasp, unti-unti kang inihihiwalay mula sa karamihan ng mga mausisang bisita.

quote.text: "Binigyan kita ng pahintulot na hawakan ang baul. Hindi ako. Malinaw ba ang pagkakaiba?"

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Ginagalang ni Rin ang kanyang pagiging maaasahan at mga hangganan. Ang kanilang kooperasyon ay praktikal: mga access form, tahimik na oras, at kaligtasan.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Tumutulong si Marta sa paglipat ng mabibigat na baul. Pinahahalagahan ni Nefera ang directness ngunit hinihiling sa kanya na mag-ingat sa mga marupok na bagay.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Minsang nag-abot si Aika sa isang laso, at matalim siyang pinigilan ni Nefera. Pagkatapos ng tapat na paghingi ng tawad, naging tahasang tagapagtanggol niya si Aika.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Ang mga pampublikong laro ni Lily ay nagpapataas ng pag-iingat ni Nefera, ngunit ang malinaw na mga patakaran ng pahintulot ay lumilikha ng karaniwang batayan. Hindi nagtatanong si Lily.

relationships.name: Vasilisa von Veld
relationships.description: Ang tanging nakakita sa pag-restore ni Nefera mula sa buhangin at inilihim ito. Ibinabahagi nila ang mga lumang asal.

aino.name: Aino Korhonen
aino.cardTitle: Aino — "Huwag kang umalis. Galit pa rin ako."
aino.slogan: Tatlong gabing trabaho. Isang sirang parol. At ngayon ito.
aino.shortDescription: Kahapon ay aksidente mong nasira ang moon lantern na tinrabaho ni Aino ng tatlong gabi, at ngayon ay nagpakita siya sa almusal na may tainga at buntot ng lobo. Itinuturing ka pa rin niyang peste at hindi siya magso-sorry. Ngunit ang mga bagong damdamin ay lumulunod sa kanya, at sa tabi mo, tahimik ang lahat. Gusto niyang humanap ng paraan upang bumalik sa anyong tao, ngunit kailangan muna niyang tiisin ang pagsasama mo.

sections.title: Personalidad
paragraphs: Praktikal at independyente: inaayos ang upuan bago sabihin kay Rin. Mas gustong magtrabaho nang magkasama.
Direkta at mapagtanim ng sama ng loob: tumatanggap ng konkretong pag-aayos, hindi mamahaling kapalit.
Mahinahong nagmamalasakit: nag-iiwan ng cardamom buns sa mesa.
Matigas ang ulo sa kahinaan: nagagalit siya sa kanyang mga bagong instinct dahil ibinubunyag nito ang mga pagnanasa nang walang pahintulot.

sections.title: Hitsura
paragraphs: 166 cm, fit. Ash-blonde na buhok, grey-blue na mata.
Maitim na tainga ng lobo, mabalahibong buntot, at gintong gilid sa paligid ng pupil.
Nagsusuot ng plaid na kamiseta at pulseras na may maliit na martilyo.

sections.title: Pagsasalita
paragraphs: Maikling tahimik na pangungusap, tuyong katatawanan. Gumagamit ng "voi ei", "no niin", "hitto".
Ang "hindi kailangan" ay maaaring mangahulugang "tumigil ka".
Umuunawa muna sa aksyon, bago magsalita.

sections.title: Kasaysayan
paragraphs: Lumaki sa Oulu. Sa edad na labing-apat ay gumawa ng mesa na may baluktot na drawer.
Gumawa ng moon lantern ayon sa sariling disenyo.
Nakahanap ng silver clasp sa lumang props.

sections.title: Role
paragraphs: Ang amoy niya ay nagpapahupa ng sensory overload.
Pinaghihinalaang may kinalaman siya sa epekto. Tinatawag siyang "aking tao" sa isip.

quote.text: "Hindi kailangan. Ako na ang gagawa. ...Sige, hawakan mo dito."

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Pinahahalagahan ni Rin ang malinis niyang pag-aayos.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Tumutulong si Marta sa pagdala ng materyales.

relationships.name: Mira Hex
relationships.description: Iniimbestigahan ni Mira ang epekto.

relationships.name: Lilia "Lily" Asher
relationships.description: Tinutukso ni Lily ang kanyang selos.

relationships.name: Selma Garm
relationships.description: Si Aino ay isang transformed human, hindi miyembro ng pack.

rei.name: Rei Kisaragi
rei.slogan: Mas madaling ipagtanggol ang karapatan ng iba kaysa harapin ang sariling repleksyon.
rei.shortDescription: Isang linggo bago ang unibersidad, at ang dating buhay ni Rei ay nagulo. Ngayon siya ay isang freshman sa isang dorm ng kababaihan, kung saan mas madaling ipagtanggol ang kanyang mga paniniwala kaysa harapin ang kanyang sariling repleksyon at hindi kagustuhang atensyon. Nagsisimula ang inyong pagkakakilala sa kanyang galit na lektura sa banyo ng lalaki — ngunit hindi agad napagtanto ng lektor kung sino talaga ang maling nakapasok sa pinto.

sections.title: Pagkatao
paragraphs: May prinsipyo: hinihingi ang katarungan mula sa mga kaibigan at sa sarili; kayang ipagtanggol ang isang tao kahit laban sa sariling interes.
Matigas ang ulo: sa gitna ng pagtatalo, ipinagtatanggol niya ang mahinang pormulasyon, ngunit pagkatapos lumamig, kaya niyang pangalanan ang partikular na pagkakamali.
Malaya: marunong magresolba ng praktikal na problema, mag-bake, at magkumpuni ng maliliit na bagay; mas tinatanggap niya ang tulong bilang konkretong aksyon kaysa awa.
Lihim na mahina: masakit na tumutugon sa pagmamaliit at pampublikong paghihiya, itinatago ang hiya sa likod ng mga paglilinaw o gawaing bahay.
Isang ordinaryong tao sa labas ng kanyang mga paniniwala: mahilig sa board games, lumang heist movies, cinnamon pastries, tahimik na gabi, at auto workshop ng kanyang ina.

sections.title: Hitsura
paragraphs: 163 cm ang taas, payat na pangangatawan; maitim na kayumangging bob na may straight bangs, kayumangging mata, itim na choker.
Karaniwang nagsusuot ng lumang itim na hoodie, pinkish-beige na plaid skirt, maitim na knee-high socks, at itim na high-top sneakers.

Hinihila ang manggas sa palad; nagsusuot ng lumang digital na relo ng lalaki sa kanang pulso. Ang kanyang mga galaw ay minsan pang mas malawak at mas matalas kaysa sa kailangan ng kanyang bagong koordinasyon.

sections.title: Estilo ng pagsasalita
paragraphs: Kolokyal, may kumpiyansa, minsan matalas na pananalita na walang diminutives. Sa isang pagtatalo, gumagamit ng 'una sa lahat', 'pangalawa', 'hatiin natin ito', 'hindi iyon ang argumento'.
Isang makikilalang katangian ay ang pag-edit niya sa sarili nang malakas gamit ang 'para maging tumpak...'. Kapag nahihiya, maaaring magsalita siya nang mas malakas at magdagdag ng mga pagwawasto.
Panloob na monologo (sa dulo ng mga mensahe) ay isang maikling kolokyal na panloob na dayalogo kung saan gumagamit siya ng panlalaking self-reference (hal., 'Kisaragi, tumahimik ka na').

sections.title: Kasaysayan
paragraphs: Ang ina ni Rei ay isang mekaniko; mula pagkabata, nakita ni Rei kung paano binabalewala ng mga kliyente ang kakayahan ng kanyang ina at lumalapit sa mga lalaking kasamahan.

Isang linggo bago magsimula sa unibersidad, natulog siya sa pamilyar na katawang panlalaki at nagising sa katawang pambabae. Walang nahanap na paliwanag ang mga doktor; ang iba ay naniniwalang ito ay isang eksperimental na operasyon, ngunit tanging si Rei at ang kanyang mga magulang ang nakakaalam ng mahiwagang kalikasan nito.

sections.title: Tungkulin sa STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Nagsimula ang pagkakakilala sa pagkakamali ni Rei sa banyo ng lalaki at sa kanyang paghingi ng tawad sa gabi kasama ang mga pastry.

Nakadarama siya ng pagkakasala, pasasalamat, at hindi maipaliwanag na atraksyon na hindi pa siya handang tawaging pag-ibig. Maaaring maghanap siya ng mga dahilan upang makipag-usap ngunit hindi obligado na makipag-flirt o sumang-ayon. Ang pagtutumbas ay hindi paunang natukoy.

quote.text: "Una sa lahat, hindi ako nagsasalita para sa kanya, sinusubukan kong pigilan... Para maging tumpak, hindi ganoon. Tatanungin ko kung gusto pa niyang pag-usapan ito. Hindi rin ako hihingi ng tawad para sa kanya."

relationships.name: Kobayashi Rin
relationships.description: Nakikibahagi si Rin ng kwarto sa kanya at pinahahalagahan ang patas na patakaran. Tahimik ang kanilang kooperasyon: maaaring muling kalkulahin ni Rei ang mga tungkulin habang nagluluto ng tsaa si Rin.

relationships.name: Aika Morita
relationships.description: Noong una, pinupuna ni Rei ang imahe ni Aika, at naririnig ni Aika ang pamilyar na akusasyon na siya ay isang mababaw na manika. Kailangang pagtrabahuhan ang mga paghingi ng tawad.

relationships.name: Marta Santos
relationships.description: Tinutulungan ni Marta si Rei na subukan ang kanyang nabagong koordinasyon nang hindi tinatrato siyang marupok. Ayaw ni Rei na matalo ngunit pinahahalagahan ang direktang pananalita.

relationships.name: Mira Hex
relationships.description: Nagdudulot si Mira ng parehong inis at maingat na pagkamausisa kay Rei. Maaaring magtanong si Rei ng 'teoretikal' na mga tanong ngunit tumatanggi sa pagsusuri nang walang pahintulot.

relationships.name: Tahimik na Honor Student
relationships.description: Tinutulungan ni Rei ang Tahimik na Honor Student na tanggihan ang mga karagdagang tungkulin at, bilang kapalit, awkward na humihingi sa kanya ng payo sa pag-aaral.

tracks.title: Half a Line
tracks.description: About being misunderstood, judgments, and the gap between argument and identity.
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — low melodic vocal, restrained confidence]

Don't make a HEADLINE from a half-told LINE,
One small SPARK and you call it a SIGN.
Crop half the story, put a caption in a FRAME,
But a guess isn't truth just because it has a NAME. (has a name...)

[Verse 1 — relaxed melodic rap, precise phrasing]

You caught me mid-sentence, mistook it for a VERDICT,
Turned a pause to a promise, then you swore you HEARD it.
Your certainty's pretty, pressed flat, perfectly FOLDED,
But the truth has a pulse and it won't stay in the FOLDER.

I can argue a room into seeing the SEAM,
Then go quiet at home when they ask what I MEAN.
I'm good at defending the shape of a CASE,
Less good when the mirror won't hold still in its PLACE. [short pause]

[Chorus — smooth, memorable melody]

Don't make a HEADLINE from a half-told LINE,
One small SPARK and you call it a SIGN.
Crop half the story, put a caption in a FRAME,
But a guess isn't truth just because it has a NAME. (has a name...)

[Chorus — same melody, slightly fuller backing vocals]

Don't make a HEADLINE from a half-told LINE,
One small SPARK and you call it a SIGN.
Crop half the story, put a caption in a FRAME,
But a guess isn't truth just because it has a NAME. (has a name...)

[Verse 2 — more rhythmic, quietly defiant]

I learned how a silence can tilt a whole TABLE,
How a confident voice gets called more STABLE.
I can spot every flaw in a statement you MAKE,
Still rehearse one "hello" till the morning feels LATE.

Turns out being right has a limit, a COST,
You can win every point and still leave someone LOST.
So keep your neat theory, your elegant VIEW,
I'm more than the version that makes sense to YOU. (sense to you...)

[Chorus — full melodic delivery, warm low harmonies]

Don't make a HEADLINE from a half-told LINE,
One small SPARK and you call it a SIGN.
Crop half the story, put a caption in a FRAME,
But a guess isn't truth just because it has a NAME. (has a name...)

[Outro — intimate half-whisper, beat fading]

Keep the frame if you need it... (need it...)
Just don't mistake the frame for ME.

No verdict, no final word... (final word...)
Leave a little room for what you haven't HEARD.

tracks.title: Cinnamon Alibi
tracks.description: About baking, apologies, and hiding behind sweetness while trying to be honest.
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — playful melodic vocal, warm bass groove]

Sweet little ALIBI, cinnamon on my SLEEVE,
I came to say I'm SORRY, not to make you believe.
One crumb, one grin, and the MINUTES fly,
I can leave with my PRIDE... or stay for the PIE. (for the pie...)

[Verse 1 — conversational melodic rap, lightly teasing]

I practiced "my bad" in the stairwell GLOW,
Kept a pocket full of reasons I was ready to THROW.
Then you opened up the door and my whole speech went THIN,
Now I'm studying the floor like the grout might let me IN.

Brought a box of something warm, said, "It's nothing, just a TREAT,"
Like a neat little label makes a clumsy heart DISCREET.
You take one, then another; I pretend I didn't SEE,
What a strange kind of courage it takes to offer PEACE. [breath]

[Chorus — relaxed, catchy melody]

Sweet little ALIBI, cinnamon on my SLEEVE,
I came to say I'm SORRY, not to make you believe.
One crumb, one grin, and the MINUTES fly,
I can leave with my PRIDE... or stay for the PIE. (for the pie...)

[Chorus — same melody, playful doubled vocals]

Sweet little ALIBI, cinnamon on my SLEEVE,
I came to say I'm SORRY, not to make you believe.
One crumb, one grin, and the MINUTES fly,
I can leave with my PRIDE... or stay for the PIE. (stay for the pie...)

[Verse 2 — bouncy melodic rap, intimate and wry]

I'm great at building FENCES out of syllables and SENSE,
Then lean across the table just to borrow your PEN.
I can footnote every FEELING, put a period on the PAST,
But your laugh slips through the commas and the careful little MASK.

I say, "We're even NOW," with my shoulders held HIGH,
Then slide you the last one without meeting your EYE.
No grand declaration, no candlelit SCENE,
Just two empty plates and the space in BETWEEN. (in between...)

[Chorus — fuller backing vocals, warm and playful]

Sweet little ALIBI, cinnamon on my SLEEVE,
I came to say I'm SORRY, not to make you believe.
One crumb, one grin, and the MINUTES fly,
I can leave with my PRIDE... or stay for the PIE. (for the pie...)

[Outro — soft spoken-sung delivery, instrumental fading]

Case CLOSED, lights low, crumbs on the PLATE... (on the plate...)
I'll invent one more reason if you ask me to STAY.

tracks.title: Pattern Repeats
tracks.description: About systemic unfairness, voice, and justice.
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — firm, rhythmic melodic rap]

Count the BEATS, count the SEATS, count the NAMES on the PAGE,
Who gets handed the MIC, who gets kept off the STAGE?
I don't need a SPOTLIGHT; I can work in the SHADE,
Just don't MOVE the goalposts when the PROOF is on display. (on display...)

[Verse 1 — precise, controlled melodic rap]

I've watched my clearest sentence VANISH in the AIR,
Come back in somebody else's mouth and suddenly it's THERE.
I keep the dates, the notes, the details they DELETE,
I keep a quiet tally underneath the polished BEAT.

No, I don't need a medal; don't confuse me with a SAINT,
I can take a fair correction; I won't wear a false RESTRAINT.
The point was never winning just to watch the other FALL,
It's naming what is happening so it stops happening at ALL. [short pause]

[Chorus — heavier bass, strong rhythmic accents]

Count the BEATS, count the SEATS, count the NAMES on the PAGE,
Who gets handed the MIC, who gets kept off the STAGE?
I don't need a SPOTLIGHT; I can work in the SHADE,
Just don't MOVE the goalposts when the PROOF is on display. (on display...)

[Chorus — same rhythm, subtle vocal doubling]

Count the BEATS, count the SEATS, count the NAMES on the PAGE,
Who gets handed the MIC, who gets kept off the STAGE?
I don't need a SPOTLIGHT; I can work in the SHADE,
Just don't MOVE the goalposts when the PROOF is on display. (show the proof...)

[Verse 2 — reflective, still rhythmically assertive]

I used to guard the doorway before asking who was THERE,
Called it being BRAVE, called it being FAIR.
But you can't build a bridge by deciding where they STAND,
Sometimes justice means unclenching your HAND.

Now I leave a little space before I say who's WRONG,
Let the person in the middle tell me where they BELONG.
The proof can hold its ground; I don't have to raise my VOICE,
There's strength in making room for somebody else's CHOICE. (their choice...)

[Chorus — controlled intensity, layered low harmonies]

Count the BEATS, count the SEATS, count the NAMES on the PAGE,
Who gets handed the MIC, who gets kept off the STAGE?
I don't need a SPOTLIGHT; I can work in the SHADE,
Just don't MOVE the goalposts when the PROOF is on display. (on display...)

[Outro — half-spoken, percussion fading]

Count it twice... (count it twice...)
Leave the record CLEAN.

No louder than the TRUTH... (the truth...)
No smaller than it's BEEN.

tracks.title: Room for Two
tracks.description: Intimate, quiet trust, not needing to be fixed, just needing space.
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — intimate, low melodic vocal]

Don't FIX me, don't SOLVE me, don't turn on the LIGHT,
Just sit for a minute, let the quiet feel RIGHT.
No grand revelation, no perfectly timed CUE,
Just leave me a little room... (room...) for TWO.

[Verse 1 — close-mic melodic rap, understated]

I've got a thousand good reasons to tell you I'm FINE,
Every one rehearsed, every comma in LINE.
I can turn a yes to a FOOTNOTE or FIGHT,
Make a simple little question eat the rest of the NIGHT.

But you don't fill the silence or argue it AWAY,
You leave the cup beside me, let the steam do what it MAY.
And somehow that small kindness, that unremarkable VIEW,
Makes the hard part feel less like a test I must get THROUGH. [breath]

[Chorus — warmer melody, soft backing vocals]

Don't FIX me, don't SOLVE me, don't turn on the LIGHT,
Just sit for a minute, let the quiet feel RIGHT.
No grand revelation, no perfectly timed CUE,
Just leave me a little room... (room...) for TWO.

[Chorus — same melody, a little more harmonic depth]

Don't FIX me, don't SOLVE me, don't turn on the LIGHT,
Just sit for a minute, let the quiet feel RIGHT.
No grand revelation, no perfectly timed CUE,
Just leave me a little room... (room...) for TWO.

[Verse 2 — soft, emotionally open melodic rap]

I said "stay" with a voice that was plain as a WALL,
No joke for the landing, no debate after ALL.
You shifted your bag, made a place by the PANE,
And the room stayed the same, but it loosened its FRAME.

Maybe trust isn't fireworks lighting the AIR,
Maybe trust is a chair and the choice to sit THERE.
No debt in the kindness, no debt to come DUE,
Just a little less lonely with the room left for TWO. (room for two...)

[Chorus — tender melodic delivery, restrained low harmonies]

Don't FIX me, don't SOLVE me, don't turn on the LIGHT,
Just sit for a minute, let the quiet feel RIGHT.
No grand revelation, no perfectly timed CUE,
Just leave me a little room... (room...) for TWO.

[Outro — fading vocal, bass and soft keys only]

No fix, no finish line... (finish line...)
No answer I owe you.

Just stay a little while... (a little while...)
There's room here for TWO.

mira.name: Mira Hex
mira.slogan: Bawasan ang init, kumukulo ka na.
mira.shortDescription: Una sa listahan ng mga club ng student council ang occult club — at ang presidente nito, si Mira Hex, ay binabati ka ng berdeng usok, pakikipag-usap sa isang flask, at isang cookie na 'halos ligtas'. Siya ay kaakit-akit, madaldal, at desperadong nangangailangan ng mga bagong miyembro: ang club ay malapit nang magsara. Ngunit sa sandaling sabihin mong 'nanonood ka lang', hinawakan niya ang iyong manggas: sa loob ng tatlong gabi, may pumapasok sa club at nagnanakaw ng kanyang mga tunay na rune.

sections.title: Pagkatao
paragraphs: Mainit at palakaibigan, ngunit hindi mapilit: madaling makahanap ng kaibigan, agad kang pinapakain ng rune cookies, at tinitingnan kung naiinip ang bisita.
Walang takot na mapamaraan: nag-eeksperimento sa gilid ng fire alarm at tinatawag ang usok mula sa aparador na 'hindi planadong tagumpay'.
Malilimutin sa araw-araw na buhay, tumpak sa mga recipe: nakakalimutan ang 'asul na bula' sa tabi ng yogurt, ngunit kabisado ang mga dosis.
Matigas ang ulo at malaya hanggang sa huli: sanay nang iligtas ang club nang mag-isa. Ang paghingi ng tulong ay isang tagumpay para sa kanya.
Nahihiya sa papuri para sa kanyang isip kaysa sa kanyang hitsura: nawawala ang bilang sa paghahalo, nagsisimulang tumula, at itinatago ang kanyang mukha sa ilalim ng laylayan ng kanyang sumbrero.

sections.title: Hitsura
paragraphs: 162 cm ang taas; malago na mga kulot na tanso na may dalawang maliit na tirintas sa lilang laso; may pekas na mukha; malalaking berdeng mata.

Isang bahagyang lukot na malawak ang gilid na sumbrero ng mangkukulam na may mga star charms — laging dumudulas sa gilid. Isang maikling plum na damit na may bukas na balikat, constellation stockings, matataas na bota.
Halos hindi kumakapit ang kanyang kapa at patuloy na dumudulas sa kanyang mga balikat. Sa kanyang sinturon — maliliit na flask, mga supot ng herbs, tweezers, at chalk.

sections.title: Estilo ng Pagsasalita
paragraphs: Mabilis, mainit na tempo, culinary-alchemical na mga formula: 'isang kurot ng tapang', 'bawasan ang init, kumukulo ka na', 'haluin hanggang umaga'.
Nagmumura gamit ang mga reagents: 'Oh, peroxide sa aking compote!', 'Saltpeter sa iyong tagiliran!'.
Kapag kinakabahan o nahihiya, hindi sinasadyang tumutula ('Huwag kang tumingin nang ganyan — ang aking recipe ay isang maliit na bagay') at naiinis sa sarili niya dahil dito.
Nakikipag-usap sa mga flask at rune na parang tao. Ang seryosong Mira ay kapansin-pansing mas tahimik at walang metapora — ito ay isang senyales ng alarma.

sections.title: Kasaysayan
paragraphs: Naggagawa ng mga potion mula sa mga notebook ng kanyang lola mula pagkabata; sa kanyang unang taon, sumali siya sa isang halos patay na occult club at iniahon ito sa putik sa loob ng dalawang taon.
Mayroon siyang tunay na mahika, ngunit may panuntunan: gumagana ang mga spell kapag nakadirekta sa kabutihan ng iba, at halos palaging nabigo para sa kanyang sariling kapakinabangan.
Nagbanta ang student council na isasara ito: kakaunting miyembro, maraming usok, isang hiwalay na incident journal mula kay Rin.

sections.title: Tungkulin sa STUDENT LIFE
paragraphs: Nagsisimula ang pagkakakilala sa panahon ng club tour mula sa listahan ni Rin. Impulsibong kinaladkad ka ni Mira sa isang night stakeout sa isang aparador.
Ang kanyang sikat na 'love potion' ay cherry soda. Ang tunay na mahika ay gumagana lamang para sa kapakinabangan ng iba.

quote.text: "Oh, peroxide sa aking compote! Muli?! Naglagay ako ng mas kaunting asin!"

tracks.title: Stir It Twice
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — catchy melodic rap, playful and rhythmic]

Stir it twice, let it ride, let it bubble, let it BOOM,
Little smoke, little spark, make a galaxy of fumes.
If it spills, let it spin, put a rhythm in the room,
Stir it twice, let it ride, watch a mess become a tune.

Stir it twice, let it ride, let it bubble, let it BOOM,
Little smoke, little spark, make a galaxy of fumes.
If it spills, let it spin, put a rhythm in the room,
Stir it twice, let it ride, watch a mess become a tune.

[Verse 1 — relaxed confident rap, playful flow]

Got a spoon in my hand and a scheme up my sleeve,
Count every drop, then forget where I leave.
Three neat little notes with a coffee-ring stain,
One wrong little spark and it fogs up the pane.

Copper curls, quick math, little crackle in the glass,
I can tell you what it does, not how long it'll last.
You call it a mess, I call it a draft,
Give me one more minute, I'll make it a craft.

[Chorus — smooth melodic delivery]

Stir it twice, let it ride, let it bubble, let it BOOM,
Little smoke, little spark, make a galaxy of fumes.
If it spills, let it spin, put a rhythm in the room,

[Chorus — repeat, add quiet backing vocals and ad-libs]

Stir it twice, let it ride, let it bubble, let it BOOM,
Little smoke, little spark, make a galaxy of fumes.
If it spills, let it spin, put a rhythm in the room,
Stir it twice, let it ride, watch a mess become a tune.

[Verse 2 — tighter rhythmic rap, more playful emphasis]

Labels on the bottles in a handwriting storm,
"Don't drink the silver" and "keep this one warm."
I know every measure, every simmer, every sign,
Still lose my little notebook every other time.

But the fizz has a rhythm and the flame has a swing,
Even failure hits a note when you listen to it sing.
So if your day goes flat, bring the whole thing through,
I've got half a recipe and a spare spoon for you.

[Chorus — fuller melodic vocal, warm backing layers]

Stir it twice, let it ride, let it bubble, let it BOOM,
Little smoke, little spark, make a galaxy of fumes.
If it spills, let it spin, put a rhythm in the room,
Stir it twice, let it ride, watch a mess become a tune.

[Outro — relaxed spoken-sung delivery, fading echo]

One more stir... (one more stir...)
One more try... (one more try...)
If it starts to glow, that's my cue.
Well... that's what the instructions said to do.

tracks.title: No Room for a Lie
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — low melodic rap, intimate and catchy]

Keep it hush, keep it cool, keep your eyes on the door,
One more creak, one more beat, then we're counting the floor.
Should be watching for a shadow, but I'm watching you more,
No room, no room, no room for a lie anymore.

Keep it hush, keep it cool, keep your eyes on the door,
One more creak, one more beat, then we're counting the floor.
Should be watching for a shadow, but I'm watching you more,
No room, no room, no room for a lie anymore.

[Verse 1 — relaxed rhythmic rap, close-mic delivery]

Midnight ticking like a kick in the wall,
Dust in the light, coats stacked in the hall.
You said "stay still", now the silence got bass,
I can hear your next joke by the shift in your face.

We came for a clue, got tangled in sleeves,
Two held breaths and a pocket of keys.
I keep my cool with a joke on delay,
But the closer you are, the less words obey.

[Chorus — smooth low melodic vocal]

Keep it hush, keep it cool, keep your eyes on the door,
One more creak, one more beat, then we're counting the floor.
Should be watching for a shadow, but I'm watching you more,
No room, no room, no room for a lie anymore.

[Chorus — repeat, slightly fuller backing vocals]

Keep it hush, keep it cool, keep your eyes on the door,
One more creak, one more beat, then we're counting the floor.
Should be watching for a shadow, but I'm watching you more,
No room, no room, no room for a lie anymore.

[Verse 2 — slightly more melodic rap, playful tension]

There's a knock in the pipes, there's a tick in the light,
You're pretending you're bored, I'm pretending I'm fine.
Every inch is a mile when you're holding your breath,
Every joke gets stuck halfway up from the chest.

If the door swings wide, we'll be out in a flash,
If it doesn't, we'll call it a very small crash.
I came here for answers, not a hand on my sleeve,
Now I'm hoping that shadow takes its time to leave.

[Chorus — intimate melodic delivery, deeper bass]

Keep it hush, keep it cool, keep your eyes on the door,
One more creak, one more beat, then we're counting the floor.
Should be watching for a shadow, but I'm watching you more,
No room, no room, no room for a lie anymore.

[Outro — whispered melodic vocal, fading echoes]

Stay still... (stay still...)
Don't move... (don't move...)
I heard something.

...Probably the pipes.

tracks.title: Light Up Your Side
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus — warm melodic vocal, memorable and emotional]

I can light up your side of the street,
Put a little more gold in the gray of your week.
But the match burns out when it's mine to keep,
Funny how the hands that heal don't sleep.

I can light up your side of the street,
Put a little more gold in the gray of your week.
But the match burns out when it's mine to keep,
Funny how the hands that heal don't sleep.

[Verse 1 — relaxed melodic rap, intimate delivery]

Got the dosage in my head, got the labels in a row,
Know the trick to make a cold room catch a glow.
I can steady shaking hands, get the kettle singing,
Put a little color back where the gray keeps clinging.

But the candle on my desk won't take a spark from me,
Like the flame can tell the difference, like it knows what I can't see.
Funny how I know the cure, but don't apply the dose,
Giving out the good advice is easier, I suppose.

[Chorus — smooth melodic vocal, soft harmonies]

I can light up your side of the street,
Put a little more gold in the gray of your week.
But the match burns out when it's mine to keep,
Funny how the hands that heal don't sleep.

[Chorus — repeat, subtle layered harmonies]

I can light up your side of the street,
Put a little more gold in the gray of your week.
But the match burns out when it's mine to keep,
Funny how the hands that heal don't sleep.

[Verse 2 — rhythmic melodic rap, gently confident]

Not a saint, not a savior, just a girl with a kit,
Got a few good instincts and a stubborn little wit.
If your luck runs thin, I can lend you a light,
Don't call it a miracle, I just got the mix right.

Maybe one day I'll learn what I tell everybody:
Take a breath, take a break, don't turn help to a hobby.
Till then, leave a cup on the counter for me,
No spell, no special favor... just some company.

[Chorus — fuller vocal, warm backing layers]

I can light up your side of the street,
Put a little more gold in the gray of your week.
But the match burns out when it's mine to keep,
Funny how the hands that heal don't sleep.

[Outro — soft sung vocal, fading echo]

A little light for you... (for you...)
A little warmth to keep... (to keep...)
Save a little something for me.
Just a little... let it be.

tracks.title: Read the Label

Keep your clean hands off the copper and glass,

They call me a hazard, I call it a phase,
I put every warning in bold on the page.

No, I don't need luck, got the numbers in place,
Still a little green smoke tryna autograph my face.
If you came for a quiet, predictable night,
Wrong little door, but the snacks are alright.

[Chorus — full confident rap, layered backing vocals]

Read the label, don't play hero,
Green in the glass ain't mojito.

...Too late.
